cleanup.instance_boundary: Terminated tombstones remain DescribeInstances-visible temporarily; all owned instances must be terminated and no nonterminal owned instance may remain. Stopped is not cleanup.

assessment.observation: Positive CPU credits survive this stopped t3.nano-to-t3.micro change; a reset to zero is excluded by an upper bound on possible post-restart earnings.
assessment.proof: The positive post-change balance was already present in the API response by post_balance_observed_at. Even earning 12 credits/hour continuously from the restart request, spending none, and ignoring stopped/pending time would only produce 0.94228 credits. T3 has no launch credits. The observed 1.21613765 therefore cannot have arisen from a zero reset.
assessment.limitations: This proves nonzero retention for this ordinary same-family increase only, not exact sub-minute metering, cross-family transfers, or a decrease below the existing earned-credit cap. The bound uses response observation time, not an assumption that a CloudWatch bucket timestamp equals the CPU sampling instant.
